main_text.p: institutum, gratiam nempe indeclinabiliter movere voluntatem: si declinabiliter, adhuc infero hoc esse verum: | Quidam qui audiverunt & didicerunt a Patre non veniunt ad Christum. | Sed latere voluit Sophista & vult hic notari certam dispositionem per gratiam effectam, qua fiat ut faciamus, quod jubetur. Sed an per hanc gratiam fiat, ut faciamus neceffario, an contingenter, declinabiliter an indeclinabiliter, lectori, quem ludificari satagit, relinquit conjiciendum, ne causam malam proderet.

2. Corvinus subti-lius quam solidè, per eos, qui audiverunt & didicerunt a Patre, intelligi vult eos qui ita audiverunt & didicerunt ut actu veniant ad Chri-stum, & sic dixisset Salvator: omnes qui actu veniunt ad Christum, ii actu veniunt ad Christum: quæ insulsa quæstio inter Christum & Capernaitas nunquam agebatur, sed quæstio erat, cur quidam veniant ad Christum, quidam non? quasi vero mortales ulli Christo mo-verent quæstionem, an qui ita moventur a Patre ut actu veniant ad Christum, ii actu veniant ad Christum? An causa cur frigus aëris intensum ut actu causatur glaciem, actu causatur glaciem? An Corvinus actu errans cum Arminio sit causa cur erroribus Arminianis perti-naciter patrocinetur, quid stultius dici potuit?

page.notes: Uncertain: the three vertical bars "|" before "Quidam", "Sed" and after "veniunt" may be printer's marks rather than punctuation; copied as printed. The paragraph divisions before "2." and "3." are read from the numbers set mid-line; the printed layout may differ. Italic words were identified by their letter shapes; the italic setting of "Christum" in the first occurrence and of "Esai." is a visual judgement. Spelling of long s has been normalised to s throughout, as required. The line ending "domi-" continues on the next page as "nus", given as the catchword.
